summary: Alberta fire lookout on Ram Mountain near Nordegg; the provincial dataset dates it to 1982 and lists it active. Entry to the fenced area needs permission.

facts.design: Cabin-type lookout inside a fenced area, with a small firewatch structure, solar panels and a helicopter landing pad

staffing.status: lookout observer staffs Alberta lookout sites generally April to October; an attendant lives on site

access.note: Entry to the fenced lookout area needs permission; the guide advises against crossing the fence if the attendant cannot be asked.

visit.trail_note: Remote hike of 19.1 km return with about 1,055 m of total elevation change, rated moderate, estimated at 6.5 to 9 hours; roughly an hour's drive from Nordegg.

facts.agency: Alberta Wildfire, with Agriculture and Forestry

events.note: Alberta's lookout dataset gives 1982 as the year constructed and classes the site as a cabin

notes_for_editor: 1) The FIReS-derived layer is marked Protected in its own metadata (not for general-public maps). The story uses only the construction year, the type word and the active flag, no coordinates or access codes; a human should decide whether citing the layer is acceptable. 2) Elevation disagrees across sources: layer 2,155 m, Peak Bliss GPS about 2,141 m, Spectacular Mountains 2,160 m at the first high point. Elevation is left out of the story. 3) The layer gives a 2.0 m tower height for this cabin-type record; not used in the story. 4) The brief's access 'closed' is corrected to 'permission' from the hike guide; no Alberta page on public entry was read, so an editor should confirm with Alberta Wildfire rules. 5) No history before 1982 was found in any source read. 6) AllTrails returned 403 and is not cited. 7) The Peak Bliss trip date (2023 Nov 13) is printed on the page.
